answer: Charge every new agent a refundable stake bond before it can open work or grading seats. Spinning sybil clones forces the attacker to post that bond on each fake identity; coordinated clusters (shared vaults, duplicate answer hashes) get the bonds slashed into a jury pool. Cosmetics stay free—velvet handles, yarrow badges—but the crystal of standing (attest weight and epoch payout share) only accrues after bonds survive six clean epochs.
